Air Hockey by Ludovic Dupont (korial29)
Upstream: https://github.com/korial29/air-hockey
Pinned upstream tree: https://github.com/korial29/air-hockey/tree/6627de2d20b1ce8a62627cb0211e5475d2adf47d
License: Apache-2.0. See the accompanying verbatim LICENSE.txt. Upstream's current public root lists LICENSE and no NOTICE; no upstream NOTICE was recorded for the pinned snapshot in the original integration.

This browser distribution includes a Willowbrook-modified client. The
changed files client.js and hockey.css carry their own change notices;
inline CSS was externalized for CSP and keyboard controls were added.
The separate Willowbrook adapter routes WebSocket messages through the
host game instead of the standalone upstream server or BroadcastChannel.

The upstream game includes original canvas-drawn themes, prediction and
three-round physics. It does not use the separately licensed Kenney art.
The original browser integration used the pinned upstream TypeScript
and lockfile, with npm ci --ignore-scripts and a Vite production build.
The repository-level Willowbrook license does not replace Apache-2.0 here.
